summary: The Hanging City is the largest Nomai settlement in the solar system, built into the thick ice beneath Brittle Hollow's Northern Glacier. It is divided into four vertically stacked districts: the Black Hole Forge District, Eye Shrine District, Meltwater District, and School District.

location: The Hanging City is a sub-location of Brittle Hollow.
Full facts about the Hanging City and its four districts are recorded in brittle_hollow.json (location bucket — search 'Hanging City').
